posts.heading: September 21, 2026
posts.text:
Tufted Titmice opened the day with a confident visual at 07:07, twelve minutes before sunrise. With 108 feeder visits and 16 species recorded so far, today trails the recent-day benchmarks of 174 visits and 18.6 species. The morning built slowly, with Northern Cardinals and Carolina Chickadees joining the Titmice by 07:10 to form the early core of traffic.

Audio activity totaled 168 detections. Carolina Wrens and American Crows dominated the soundscape in the early hours, while Ruby-throated Hummingbirds and Eastern Towhees provided intermittent accents.
